hero_title: AI that reaches production — not just a pilot.
hero_subtitle: I help startups, scale-ups and SMEs in Spain and the EU turn AI from an idea into working processes with measurable results.
about_title: Strategy and hands-on delivery, from the same person.
about_intro: I am a product and technology executive with over ten years of experience across B2C, B2B, B2B2C, platforms and AI/ML. As Director of AI at Finom, a European neobank for SMEs, I built the AI function from scratch, defined an AI-first strategy and shipped more than ten production solutions — from document processing to agentic systems for customer support, transaction monitoring and client verification.
about_body: Before that, as Director of Products at Tinkoff, I led a B2B2C business unit with 10M+ monthly active users, 1,000+ partners and a team of 150+, growing annual revenue 1.5× to the $100M mark. Most of the market sits at one extreme: large consultancies bring strategy without execution, freelance developers execute without business context. I cover the whole cycle — audit, roadmap, working solution, team training.
about_location: Based in Tarragona, Catalonia. Working remotely across Spain and the EU.

about_creds.d: Executive roles building and leading product organisations, most recently as Director of AI in a European neobank.
Shipping from zero inside small teams, and running products used by millions — one business unit grown 1.5× to a nine-figure revenue run-rate.
Chatbots and internal assistants, customer support, document and back-office processing, quality and risk monitoring — all running in production, not in demos.

about_diffs.d: Applied physics, mathematics and computer science at MIPT — a working understanding of algorithms, data and system architecture, not just off-the-shelf tools.
High-load products with millions of users, and hands-on work inside small startup teams where one person ships end to end.
Every stage has a deliverable and a target metric. You end up with something your team can run without me.

testimonial_quote: Had a great time working with Sergey at Finom! He was a Head of AI who basically took our AI initiatives from zero to one, launching several AI agents even when we had pretty limited resources. He's super into numbers and data, and it shows in everything he does. Definitely recommend him for any data-driven challenge!
testimonial_role: Co-founder and Chief AI Officer, Finom
